_note: v2 hook overrides for la Ruelle du Sommeil (ST_sommeil, S02_home), a snowy lantern lane of half-timbered cottages on a winter morning, the first half of the daily-routine street (ST_routine seg001-004). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the reflexive verbs.

fr_allonger_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pulls his striped scarf between his hands and makes it LONGER and LONGER (ah-lohn-ZHAY).
fr_allonger_verb.why: LONG → allonger = to lengthen, to stretch out (allonger le bras); s'allonger = to lie down (elle s'allonge sur le canapé). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_relever_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe bends down and RE-LIFTS the toppled lantern: he RAISES it upright again, like a LEVER (ruh-luh-VAY).
fr_relever_verb.why: Re + LEVER (lift) → relever = to lift back up, to raise (il relève la tête et sourit); also to note, pick out. RED beret = regular -er. (je relève, nous relevons).

fr_asseoir_verb.hook: Mirror in hand, Monsieur Verbe SWERVES round the lamp post and SITS DOWN on the wooden bench: "SAH, SWERVE!" (sah-SWAHR).
fr_asseoir_verb.why: A SEAT → s'asseoir = to sit down (asseyez-vous, s'il vous plaît); assis = seated. Reflexive: the mirror; être (elle s'est assise). GOLD beret = irregular (je m'assieds, nous nous asseyons, assis).

fr_habiter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe waves from the window of his own little cottage: this is his HABITAT, where he LIVES (ah-bee-TAY).
fr_habiter_verb.why: HABITAT, inHABIT → habiter = to live (in), to inhabit (j'habite à Lyon, il habite une petite maison). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_reveiller_verb.hook: The rooster crows and Monsieur Verbe sits up in bed with his mirror, yawning: REVEILLE! He WAKES UP (ray-vay-YAY).
fr_reveiller_verb.why: REVEILLE (the morning bugle call) → se réveiller = to wake up (je me réveille à sept heures); réveiller = to wake someone; un réveil = an alarm clock. Reflexive: the mirror; être. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_ennuyer_verb.hook: Chin in his hand, mirror beside him, Monsieur Verbe sighs at the table: pure ENNUI, he is BORED (ahn-nwee-YAY).
fr_ennuyer_verb.why: ENNUI (boredom) → s'ennuyer = to be bored (je m'ennuie un peu ici); ennuyer = to bore, to annoy. Reflexive: the mirror; être. RED beret = regular -er. (je m'ennuie, nous nous ennuyons).

fr_baigner_verb.hook: Mirror in hand, Monsieur Verbe BATHES in a bubbly wooden tub with his rubber duck, his own little foamy BAY (bay-NYAY).
fr_baigner_verb.why: Se baigner = to bathe, to go for a swim (les enfants se baignent dans la mer); une baignoire = a bathtub. Reflexive: the mirror; être. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_debarrasser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe carries the dirty plates and cups away on a tray: the BARE table is CLEARED (day-bah-rah-SAY).
fr_debarrasser_verb.why: Dé + BARRier (out of the way) → débarrasser = to clear (peux-tu débarrasser la table ?), to get rid of; se débarrasser de = to get rid of. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_eloigner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe carries the ladder away from the wall, further and further: he MOVES it AWAY, a LOIN's length off (ay-lwah-NYAY).
fr_eloigner_verb.why: Loin (far) → éloigner = to move away, to take further away (éloigne la chaise du mur); s'éloigner = to go away. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_nettoyer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe sponges the window until it is NEAT and sparkling: he CLEANS it (nay-twah-YAY).
fr_nettoyer_verb.why: NEAT, net (clean) → nettoyer = to clean (je nettoie la cuisine). RED beret = regular -er. (je nettoie, nous nettoyons).

fr_effacer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe rubs the chalk squiggles off the blackboard with his felt: he ERASES them, EFFACING them (ay-fah-SAY).
fr_effacer_verb.why: EFFACE → effacer = to erase, wipe off (efface le tableau, s'il te plaît); une gomme = an eraser. RED beret = regular -er. (nous effaçons).

fr_brosser_verb.hook: Mirror in hand, Monsieur Verbe BRUSHES his hair with a big hairbrush (broh-SAY).
fr_brosser_verb.why: BRUSH → se brosser = to brush (one's hair, teeth) (je me brosse les cheveux); une brosse = a brush. Reflexive: the mirror; être. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_froler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ducks as the paper airplane FROLICS past, just BRUSHING his nose (froh-LAY).
fr_froler_verb.why: Frôler = to brush against, to skim past (le ballon a frôlé ma tête). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_garnir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe carries his cream cake topped with strawberries: he has GARNISHED it (gahr-NEER).
fr_garnir_verb.why: GARNISH → garnir = to garnish, to fill, to decorate (elle garnit le gâteau de fraises); also to furnish. GREEN beret = regular -ir (nous garnissons).

fr_meubler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe carries an armchair to the lamp-lit room: he FURNISHES it with MOVABLE furniture (muh-BLAY).
fr_meubler_verb.why: Un meuble (a piece of furniture, MOVABLE) → meubler = to furnish (ils meublent leur nouvel appartement). RED beret = regular -er.
